blocks.h2: First Steps During a Sewer Backup

steps.body: No flushing, laundry or dishwasher. Ask everyone in the house to stop.
Sewage carries bacteria. Keep kids and pets upstairs.
Stay away from outlets and appliances near the water.
Tell us where the water is coming up.

tiles.body: A low spot that collects paper and wipes.
They form plugs even in healthy pipe.
Saturated ground and full sewers during wet seasons.

blocks.intro: In July 2017, the Fox River rose high enough that volunteers filled more than 25,000 sandbags, and homes along La Fox River Drive were threatened.

items.body: With more than half of homes built in the 1990s and 2000s, many basements are finished, with bathrooms. A backup there is costly.
High groundwater adds water to sewer systems and to cracked private lines.
A clean line, a backflow valve and an [overhead sewer system](/algonquin/overhead-sewer-systems) each handle part of the problem.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: Why did my basement back up when it hasn't rained?
items.preview: Usually a blockage in your line: roots, a sag, wipes or grease.
items.answer: Dry-weather backups usually mean a blockage in your own line. Roots, a sag, wipes or grease are the common causes. We clear it and show you which.

items.q: Does homeowners insurance cover sewer backups?
items.preview: Often only with a specific rider.
items.answer: Many policies only cover backups with a specific rider. Check with your agent before you need it.

items.q: Should I clean it up myself?
items.preview: Small spills on concrete, carefully. Bigger ones need pros.
items.answer: Small spills on bare concrete can be cleaned with gloves and disinfectant. Anything on carpet, drywall or furniture needs a professional cleanup company.

items.q: How do I stop it from happening again?
items.preview: Fix the cause and protect the basement.
items.answer: Fix what caused it and add protection. [Sewer maintenance](/algonquin/sewer-maintenance) plus a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/algonquin/overhead-sewer-systems) covers most homes.

items.q: My basement backed up while the river was high. Is it related?
items.preview: Possibly. High water adds load to the sewer system.
items.answer: Possibly. When the Fox River and groundwater are high, more water gets into sewer systems. Your own line may still have a problem, so we clear it and camera it to be sure.

items.q: What does sewer backup service cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused it and how we reach the line. We quote a flat rate before we start.
